# **RAG Chatbot Architecture Doc**

## **1\. Phase 1: Offline Ingestion (Building the Index)**

This phase runs once per book to process raw files into a structured, vectorless hierarchical summary navigation tree.

`[Raw PDF Book]`     
`│`    
 `▼ (PyMuPDF / fitz)`    
`[High-Res Page Images]`     
`│`    
 `▼ (Tesseract OCR)`    
`[Raw Text Extraction]`     
`│`    
 `▼ (Chunking Engine)`    
`[6-Page Sequential Leaf Nodes]`     
`│`    
 `▼ (Gemini API / gemini-flash-lite)`    
`[Hierarchical Summary Tree & Navigation Branches]`    
 `│`    
 `▼ (Local Disk Storage)`    
`💾 tree.json (Navigation Tree) + 💾 pages.jsonl (Raw Text Chunks)`

## **Phase 2: Runtime Execution (Answering Queries)**

This workflow executes in real-time when a user enters a question into the front-end chat interface.

`[User Types Question]`    
 `│`    
 `▼`    
 `[FastAPI Web Router]`    
 `│`    
 `▼`    
 `[Gemini API: Tree Traversal] ───Reads───> 💾 tree.json`    
 `│`    
 `▼ (Locates relevant leaf node IDs)`    
 `[Local Context Assembly] ───Fetches──> 💾 pages.jsonl`    
 `│`    
 `▼ (Retrieves exact raw text strings)`    
 `[Gemini API: Bounded Generation]`     
`│ (Enforces strict grounding; returns null if missing)`    
 `▼`    
 `[Citation Engine] (Appends titles & exact page numbers)`    
 `│`    
 `▼`    
 `[FastAPI Response & Frontend UI]`  

## **3\. Repository Composition & Modular Layout**

| Module / Path | Target File / Component | Core Operational Mapping | System Stage |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| app/api/(Interface Layer) | server.py | FastAPI routes & application entry points (/chat, /health) | Runtime QA |
| app/api/(Interface Layer) | static/index.html | Native premium dark-mode UI & asynchronous chat JavaScript | Runtime QA |
| app/ingest/(Extraction Layer) | pdf\_loader.py | PyMuPDF page-to-image rendering \+ Tesseract OCR processing | Ingestion Stage |
| app/ingest/(Extraction Layer) | pipeline.py | Orchestrates the sequence: Load ➔ Extract ➔ Build Structure ➔ Save | Ingestion Stage |
| app/pageindex/(Index Layer) | indexer.py | Leverages Gemini API to recursively build a summary mapping tree | Ingestion Stage |
| app/pageindex/(Index Layer) | store.py | Handles disk I/O operations for reading/writing index files | Both Stages |
| app/llm/(AI Gateway) | gemini\_client.py | Robust REST wrapper managing API communication, retries, and rates | Both Stages |
| app/qa/(Query Engine) | engine.py | Executes tree-traversal logic and enforces strictly bounded generation | Runtime QA |
| Global Configurations | app/config.py | Pydantic base settings management for environment vars/API keys | Both Stages |
| Global Configurations | app/models.py | Shared schemas and explicit Pydantic response/node layouts | Both Stages |
| Deployment & Dev Tasks | scripts/ingest\_books.py | Command line interface entry point to run ingestion loops | Ingestion Stage |
| Deployment & Dev Tasks | vercel.json | Deployment profile instructing production server routing definitions | Deployment Stage |

## **Update Log: May 25 \- June 3**

### **Architecture Transition & Pipeline Upgrades**

This section summarizes the transition from Google Gemini to Mistral API, the UI redesign, and the custom parser updates in the document retrieval pipeline.

### **1\. Pipeline & Architecture Shifts**

Below is the schematic showing the change in the retrieval and generation path:

`graph TD`  
    `%% Styling`  
    `classDef old fill:#f3f4f6,stroke:#9ca3af,stroke-width:1px,stroke-dasharray: 5 5;`  
    `classDef new fill:#1e3a8a,stroke:#2563eb,stroke-width:2px,color:#fff;`  
    `classDef shared fill:#1f2937,stroke:#4b5563,stroke-width:1px,color:#fff;`

    `%% Elements`  
    `UserQuery([User Question]) --> TreeSearch[Tree Retreiver: PageIndexStore]`  
      
    `subgraph Old Pipeline [Gemini-based Architecture]`  
        `GeminiClient[Google Gemini Client]:::old`  
        `RawMatch[Strict String Match]:::old`  
    `end`

    `subgraph Current Pipeline [Mistral-based Architecture]`  
        `MistralClient[Mistral Large Client]:::new`  
        `RobustMatch[Robust Parsing & Substring Match]:::new`  
        `RateLimit[Exponential Backoff / Retry Wrapper]:::new`  
    `end`

    `TreeSearch --> |Requires LLM Selection| GeminiClient`  
    `TreeSearch --> |Requires LLM Selection| MistralClient`  
      
    `GeminiClient --> |Returned plain ID| RawMatch`  
    `MistralClient --> |Returned decorated ID string| RobustMatch`  
      
    `RobustMatch --> |Node resolved successfully| PageExtractor[Page Content Extractor]:::shared`  
    `PageExtractor --> FinalAnswer[Mistral Generator]:::new`  
    `FinalAnswer --> Output([Grounded Answer + Citations])`

### **2\. Key Architecture Comparison**

| Component | Before (Gemini Version) | Now (Mistral Version) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Model** | gemini-flash-lite-latest | mistral-large-latest |
| **API Client** | Google GenAI SDK | Lightweight MistralClient (via native urllib.request) |
| **Tree Retrieval Prompt** | Loose JSON format | Clean structured field format (Node ID, Title, Pages, Summary) |
| **Parser Logic** | Strict exact match on ID string | Robust parser (Exact match → split clean → substring match) |
| **Error / Rate Handling** | Relied on SDK defaults | Custom exponential backoff retrying on HTTP 429 / 500 / 503 |
| **Fonts** | Browser Defaults / Outfit | **Jost** (body) & **Goudy Bookletter 1911** (headings) |
| **Color Theme** | Standard dark (purple accents) | Clean premium dark theme with **slight dark blue accents** |
| **Asset Icons** | Emojis | Pure, minimalist vector SVGs |

### **3\. The Tree Descent Repair**

![][image1]

The primary breakdown point with Mistral was node ID parsing during tree traversal:

`sequenceDiagram`  
    `participant R as Retriever`  
    `participant M as Mistral LLM`  
    `participant P as Robust Parser`

    `R->>M: Send children list (Node ID: BOOK_1-ROOT, Title: ...)`  
    `M-->>R: Return JSON containing selected_ids: ["BOOK_1-ROOT | 02_T_ENERGY..."]`  
      
    `rect rgb(30, 58, 138)`  
        `Note over R,P: The Robust Parser Step`  
        `R->>P: Check matches for "BOOK_1-ROOT | 02_T_ENERGY..."`  
        `P->>P: 1. Exact Match? No.`  
        `P->>P: 2. Split on "|" & Check first part ("BOOK_1-ROOT")? Yes!`  
        `P->>P: 3. Substring check? (Matches as fallback)`  
        `P-->>R: Resolved Node ID: "BOOK_1-ROOT"`  
    `end`  
      
    `R->>R: Proceed down to leaf nodes successfully.`
